morphology.pattern_note: di- 为被动前缀，与 -kan 组合，词根无音变；按给定分类记作 circumfix。输入包的根词标注已依 DBP 的 sabit 法律义更正；对应主动式为 mensabitkan，保留 s。

senses.zh_definition: 被法院判定有罪；被定罪。
senses.en_definition: To be convicted or formally found guilty of an offence.
senses.ms_definition: Diputuskan bersalah oleh mahkamah setelah kesalahan dibuktikan.
senses.nuances: 为被动形式，本身不标示过去时。须区分 didakwa（被控）、ditangkap（被捕）及 disabitkan（被定罪）；定罪也不自动等于判监。[马来西亚公共服务局：sabitan／disabitkan 的法定释义](https://docs.jpa.gov.my/docs/myppsm/PA/Akta-605/21/)

collocations.en: be convicted on a theft charge

senses.zh_definition: 指罪责或违法事实根据证据被确认成立。
senses.en_definition: Of guilt or an offence: to be established by evidence.
senses.ms_definition: Dibuktikan atau ditentukan dengan pasti berdasarkan keterangan.
senses.nuances: 侧重罪责成立的证明结果，主语可以是 kesalahan；与上一义属于同一法律过程的不同表述角度。此处源于 sabit 的“确立、证实”义，与表示镰刀的同形词有别。[DBP：sabit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sabit)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Tertuduh disabitkan atas tuduhan mencuri setelah mahkamah meneliti semua keterangan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 法院审查全部证据后，裁定被告盗窃罪成立。
dual_scenarios.en: The accused was convicted of theft after the court examined all the evidence.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia dah disabitkan kesalahan ke, atau baru didakwa je?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah dia sudah disabitkan kesalahan, atau baru sahaja didakwa?
dual_scenarios.zh: 他已经被定罪了，还是才刚被起诉而已？
dual_scenarios.en: Has he been convicted, or has he only been charged?
spoken_features: je 对应 sahaja，表示“而已”
法律术语 disabitkan 在口语中仍保留完整形式

messages.zh: 他已经被定罪了，还是才刚被起诉而已？

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Baru didakwa je. Kes dia belum selesai lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Dia baru sahaja didakwa. Kesnya masih belum selesai.
messages.zh: 只是刚被起诉。他的案子还没审完呢。
messages.en: He's only been charged. His case isn't over yet.

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies the legal sense of sabit as an Arabic borrowing associated with certainty and established guilt. Malay adds its own affixes to form mensabitkan, disabitkan and sabitan. The word therefore illustrates how a borrowed base becomes productive within Malay grammar, while remaining distinct from the homonymous word for a sickle. [DBP: sabit](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sabit)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 di- 的“被”和 sabit 的“证实”：罪责被证实，人就可能被 disabitkan（定罪）。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈论真实人物时准确交代案件阶段；只有被控时应说 didakwa，已经被法院定罪才说 disabitkan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于司法报道、法律文件和严肃讨论。转述案件时说明消息来源，避免把指控直接说成已经成立的罪责。
